argumentRows: four RGB565/palette configurations with two or three channels
the same configurations shifted by four bytes
zeroed pointers and a zero count
one to three channels, four channel patterns, and palette table lookups
validation.comparison: Every comparison asserts the return value or trap constructor/message, all 67,108,864 bytes of linear memory, and the stack pointer. 2282/2283 return p2*4 even though the packed value is 16-bit; the differential test caught both the missing base OR word and the full 32-bit store.
limitations: The palette table at 104976 is seeded with three entries per comparison; other table entries follow the same load.
2281/2286/2287 use shift bytes 0/8/16 and full-byte channel masks; other masks follow the same AND/shift chain.
2282/2283 cover the 0xfc1f/0x3e0 and 0xf81f/0x7e0 base and green masks.
These five functions are part of the 4,245 client functions; the ledger has 291 client bodies recovered and 3,954 remain machine code.
